text:
aj_support: FYI priority: BetaFoods onboarding blocked — SSO provisioning failing with 403 during token exchange. Trial ends in 5d, onboarding call tomorrow 10am PT. Need CS to own customer comms and opt-in for workaround. @maria_cs @kevin_reeng @sara_enablement

SupportBot: Ticket TKT-4579 created https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-4579 :rotating_light:

maria_cs: copying in. Has support confirmed reproducible? which IdP?

aj_support: reproduced on staging and prod flows. IdP: Okta (SAML). Error: HTTP 403 invalid_grant "SAML assertion not accepted by IdP for audience"

kevin_reeng: likely audience mismatch or clock skew. Ask customer to confirm SP entityID and NTP <5m. We can enable OAuth fallback toggle as a temporary fix to let them activate; requires customer consent.

maria_cs: propose comms plan:
- immediate ack + ETA for workaround 2-4h, full fix 24-48h
- schedule 30m troubleshooting call today 2pm PT with their admin + infra eng
- request OAuth fallback opt-in in writing

Draft message to customer:
"Hi Amy — we see your SSO provisioning failing due to a token exchange error. We can enable a temporary OAuth fallback to complete activation immediately and then work with your Okta admin on a permanent SAML fix. Proposed troubleshooting call today at 2pm PT. Reply with OK to proceed with fallback or confirm availability for the call."

sara_enablement: Ian prepare a short runbook with the toggle command snippets and checklist, ETA 30m.

aj_support: tagging renewal risk: account shows trial-to-paid intent; if activation slips we risk churn. Marking CS priority in ticket.

maria_cs: action items (owners & due): send customer note + get consent (maria) due 30m; enable OAuth fallback if consent (kevin) due 2h; prep runbook (sara) due 30m; update ticket TKT-4579 (aj) ongoing. Please react :thumbsup: when aligned.

kevin_reeng: :thumbsup: on standby for toggle.

sara_enablement: :thumbsup: adding runbook to ticket.

maria_cs: Amy replied: "OK to proceed with OAuth fallback and 2pm PT call." Invite sent, assigning follow-ups in TKT-4579. Will loop back after call. :white_check_mark:
